item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las mi shig gsang ba'i rdzong chen
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni mkha' 'gro dbang gi sgron ma dang mchog sprul g.yung drung dang rdza sprul yid bzhin sogs dad ldan skyes bu du mas bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas rin po che zangs kyi mkha' 'gro'i brda' ris bzhugs pa dag par phab ste/ yi ge pa ni mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyi bgyis pas 'gro kun mi 'jigs srung mkhar tshud pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
